name: FarmFresh
description: AI-powered farmers marketplace — agentic Claude shopping assistant, Stripe payments, per-farmer PDF invoicing. Next.js 15 + Postgres. Live demo.

paragraphs: A production-deployed, full-stack marketplace that connects local farmers directly with customers — real Stripe payments, per-farmer PDF invoicing, an agentic AI shopping assistant, and a full admin console. Built to production standards: atomic money handling, signature-verified webhooks, role-based access control, a Vitest suite in CI, and a WCAG-AA accessibility pass.
features: Customer — browse/search with server-side pagination, cart, Stripe Checkout, order history with live status + self-service cancel, downloadable invoices, support tickets, notifications, and the AI shopping assistant.

Farmer — dashboard with stats, product CRUD (Cloudinary uploads, flexible key/value attributes, AI-drafted descriptions), order management scoped to their own line items with legal status transitions, refunds, and their…
Admin — console with overview stats, and user / order / product / support-ticket management (seeded role, not self-assignable).
